#46146 added an `_is_sm103` check to dynamic cuDNN routing, but the existing B200 test fixture omitted that attribute. This causes three `AttributeError` failures in the diffusion unit suite on main.

Set `_is_sm103=False` in that fixture. Production routing and test assertions remain unchanged.

Validation: both existing routing and selection test files passed on an isolated H200 environment (6 tests); pre-commit passed.
